Breadboard positions are read from the circuit image: the potentiometer straddles the centre gap in columns 10, 11 and 12. Its two outer pins are in the bottom half (10b.e and 12b.e) and its middle pin is in the top half (11t.f).
The pot's outer pins are interchangeable, so the black GND wire and red 5V wire could be swapped. The pot is assigned GND to column 10 (black wire) and VCC to column 12 (red wire), as in the image.
The black wire goes to the Uno GND header next to the POWER label, which is GND.2 in the image. The red wire goes to 5V. The yellow wire goes from the wiper strip (column 11, top half) to A0.
Matches the schematic: 5V to one outer pin, GND to the other outer pin, wiper to A0.
